title.narrative: Bekämpfung und Prävention verschiedener Formen von Kinderarbeit auf den Philippinen
Combating and preventing various forms of child labour in the Philippines

description.narrative: Child labour remains a serious problem in the Philippines, especially in rural areas and the sugar cane industry. In 2023, around 3.5 per cent of children were employed. Although laws prohibit child labour under the age of 15 and hazardous work under the age of 18, many local authorities lack the resources and knowledge to enforce them. Children as young as seven work in dangerous conditions, with long working hours and low wages on plantations.
